color.note: Placeholder palette: neutral greys plus one teal accent, so the look is easy to swap. Re-brand by changing values here; keep the names.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the background of cards, fields and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Product image wells, loading placeholders, info notices and disabled controls. Text on it: `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `surface`, `surface-muted`, `accent-subtle`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (categories, hints, captions, optional markers) on `surface` and `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges and dividers. Never the only cue for a control; use `border-control` for that.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of text fields, secondary buttons and chips. Holds 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected chip fill, links and ghost-button text, on `surface` and `surface-muted`. The one brand colour to replace.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the primary button; text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons and tint areas. `ink` or `accent` text reads on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour, 2px solid. Holds 3:1 on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `accent-subtle`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text, icon and border of a success notice, on `success-bg`. Always paired with a title or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a success notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error field borders and the danger notice, on `surface` and `danger-bg`. Always paired with a message or title, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a danger notice.

type.note: System font stack on purpose: no font files to host, and nothing to replace until the branding lands. To adopt a brand font, add it under `fonts/`, list it in `type.fonts` and change `families.sans`.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the home hero. Use `t-heading-lg` on narrow screens.

styles.name: t-heading-md
styles.usage: Section and form titles, such as the enquiry form heading.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: Paragraphs and the text inside fields. 16px keeps mobile browsers from zooming into fields.
styles.sample: Tell us what you would like to know.

styles.name: t-body-sm
styles.usage: Hints, error messages and notice bodies.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Button text, field labels, chip text and notice titles.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Product category line and other small metadata, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: t-price
styles.usage: Product prices on cards and in the enquiry summary.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use these steps for every gap and padding; do not invent in-between values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to field, icon to text in tight rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between a card's title and price.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding, gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card body padding, stack gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between grid cards, padding around product images.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks and skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product cards and the enquiry form panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Category chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting product card, over `border`.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Product card on hover.

layout.note: Breakpoints cannot be CSS variables; see the README for 600px and 960px.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content.

tokens.name: card-min
tokens.usage: Minimum product card width; `ProductGrid` fits as many columns as this allows.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and fields.
